writingPrompts.label: AP

writingPrompts.label: College Freshman

writingPrompts.label: College Sophomore

writingPrompts.label: College Junior

writingPrompts.label: College Senior

writingPrompts.label: Graduate / PhD

segments.script: News traveled quickly through gossip networks in the gentry. Mr. Bennet's laughter is painful dramatic irony. Characterization: Mr. Bennet reads Collins's letter warning against the match and laughs at the idea of Darcy loving Elizabeth. Irony: Mr. Bennet's joke wounds Elizabeth, who cannot laugh. Watch for rank and condescension: Rank is displayed and enforced, above all at Rosings by Lady Catherine; Elizabeth refuses to be cowed. In this chapter: “appeared, had actually taken the trouble of this journey from Rosings, for the sole purpose of breaking off her supposed engagement with” (Chapter LVII, paragraph 1).
